data.name: Arhita
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word ‘arhita’ which means ‘one to whom a debt is owed’. It is derived from the root ‘arh’ meaning ‘to deserve’. This name signifies the concept of giving and receiving, symbolizing a deep bond or commitment. It is often given to a child born into a family where there is a strong sense of duty and responsibility.
